title: Company OS Agent
description: Neutral agent (persona) schema. Source-of-truth for all runtime adapters.

tools.description: Logical tool capabilities the persona uses. Adapters map to the runtime's tool names.

model.description: Recommended model tier (e.g. opus, sonnet, haiku). Runtimes pick concrete model IDs.

memory.description: Where persistent memory should be stored. Runtimes that don't support memory ignore this.
